lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting Wednesday 2026-08-19.
A session is set for Wednesday: you cook on Monday and Friday, and nothing cooked then can feed the days before it. It is a day you did not ask for.
One meal is skipped, you marked it away from home.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Cool cucumber skyr crunch
dishes.title: Skyr, oats, cucumber and rye crispbreads
dishes.method: Stir the oats and pepper into the skyr. Add the diced cucumber and eat with the crispbreads.
dishes.why: This is a large, simple breakfast anchored by skyr, with crisp cucumber as the loud vegetable.

dishes.name: Smoky lentil crispbreads
dishes.title: Smoked-paprika lentils, cucumber and rye crispbreads
dishes.method: Spoon one freshly cooked portion of lentils into a bowl. Add diced cucumber and use the crispbreads for scooping.
dishes.why: The lentils provide a cheap vegetarian anchor for a small lunch while smoked paprika answers this week's craving.

dishes.name: Creamy smoky lentil bowl
dishes.title: Warm smoked-paprika lentils, radishes, skyr and rye bread
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of lentils until piping hot if it has cooled. Top with skyr and sliced radishes, then serve with the rye bread.
dishes.why: Warm lentils prevent dinner becoming a cold salad plate, while peppery radishes make the vegetable unmistakable.

dishes.name: Radish cottage cheese stack
dishes.title: Cottage cheese, radishes, cucumber and rye bread
dishes.method: Spread the cottage cheese over the bread and season with pepper. Add sliced radishes and cucumber.
dishes.why: Cottage cheese makes this substantial enough for the student's large breakfast, with crisp seasonal vegetables on top.

dishes.name: Smoky lentil wrap
dishes.title: Smoked-paprika lentils and cucumber in a wholemeal wrap
dishes.method: Spread one cold portion of the thick lentils over the wrap, add diced cucumber and roll firmly.
dishes.why: This turns Wednesday's lentils into a compact small lunch that can travel easily on a driving day.

dishes.name: Hot lentils with cool curds
dishes.title: Warm smoked-paprika lentils, cottage cheese, cucumber and rye bread
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of lentils until piping hot. Spoon over the cottage cheese, add diced cucumber and serve with the rye bread.
dishes.why: The hot lentils give dinner its required warm element, while the cool cottage cheese changes the batch into a distinct plate.

dishes.name: Paprika breakfast cakes
dishes.title: Crisp egg, potato and courgette cakes with skyr and cucumber
dishes.method: Put one freshly cooked serving of cakes on the plate. Add the skyr and diced cucumber alongside so the crisp crust stays intact.
dishes.why: The egg cakes provide the proper smoked-paprika crust requested and make a substantial breakfast before the changed night run.

dishes.name: Crisp cake lunch box
dishes.title: Egg, potato and courgette cakes with cottage cheese and radishes
dishes.method: Reheat one serving of cakes until hot. Pack or plate them with the cottage cheese and sliced radishes.
dishes.why: The second serving becomes a quick small lunch before the night shift, without creating food for the written-off evening.

preparations.title: Thick smoked-paprika lentils with courgettes
preparations.method: Dice the courgettes. Heat the oil in a large saucepan, cook the courgettes for 5 minutes, then stir in the paprika and cumin. Add the rinsed lentils and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft and thick. Season, eat one portion and divide the other three between covered containers; refrigerate promptly.

preparations.title: Crisp smoked-paprika egg and courgette cakes
preparations.method: Coarsely grate the potatoes and courgettes, then squeeze them firmly in a clean tea towel. Mix with the eggs, oats, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Shape eight thin cakes and fry in two batches for about 4 minutes on each side, pressing them flat so they develop a proper crust. Serve four for breakfast and refrigerate the other four promptly for lunch.

cooking_sessions.run_through: This added Wednesday session feeds the days before the student's usual cooking day. Put the saucepan on first, dice and soften the courgettes, then add the spices, lentils and water. While the pot simmers, set out three containers. Eat one portion, box three and refrigerate them promptly.

Cook before breakfast rather than during the written-off evening. Grate and squeeze the vegetables, mix the cake batter and heat the frying pan. Fry the thin cakes in two batches, putting the first four on the breakfast plate and cooling the other four briefly before refrigerating them for lunch.
